title: Positivity of stretched Littlewood-Richardson coefficients for partitions of length at most five
summary: For partitions lambda, mu, nu the Littlewood-Richardson coefficient stretches to a function P(t) = c(t*nu; t*lambda, t*mu) which, by a theorem of Derksen and Weyman, is a polynomial in t. King, Tollu and Toumazet conjectured that P has no negative coefficient. The conjecture is known only for c <= 2 and is otherwise open. We prove it for all triples whose parts number at most five.
